## Activity

During November 2020, Harbour Eye Clinic completed 305 photographic captures. This activity represents the total number of image sets submitted for assessment during the reporting month. The service maintained its planned capture activity, with all submitted sets progressing to the image-quality review stage.

## Image quality

Of the 305 captures, 21 were marked ungradable. This corresponds to an ungradable rate of 6.9. Ungradable sets could not proceed to clinical grading because the submitted images did not meet the required standard for assessment. Staff raised no new equipment faults this month.

## Grading

A total of 56 results were graded referable. These results were identified through the grading process for appropriate clinical follow-up in line with service arrangements. The median grading wait was 1 day. Overall, the report records activity from capture through image-quality review and grading, with the ungradable results and referable outcomes noted for service monitoring.
